steps.clue: Place the amulet in the temple to open the Dark Aether Nexus.
Collect the Monocle and complete the Bull and Hunter mural lockdowns to obtain the Staff parts.
Defend the Staff of Ice during its construction in the Dark Aether Nexus.
Freeze three lanterns within ten seconds.
Lower three symbol rocks, then shoot their symbols on the blocked gateway.
Escort the purple orb to upgrade the Staff of Ice.
Complete the Vermin and Parasite statue trials and return their energy.
Complete the Doppelghast and Amalgam statue trials and return their energy.
Cross the opened bridge and defeat the Sentinel Artifact.
